question: En az 100 siparişi olan kategoriler arasında geç teslim oranı en yüksek 5'i hangileri?
golden_sql: SELECT category, 1.0 * SUM(late) / COUNT(*) AS rate FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > DATE(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS late FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) <= '2018-09-01') GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY rate DESC, category LIMIT 5
